transcript.text: microwve plate wont go round anymore, food hot on one side cold on other. still heats tho
From what you have described, the most likely cause is tray seated correctly / obstruction. Next: Reseat the tray on the coupler/rollers and clear any obstruction. Let me know what you find.
ok tried that, the plate sits on the middle bit but it wobbles a bit. still doesnt turn. nothing in the way that i can see

From what you have described, the most likely cause is turntable coupler. When it should turn, does the motor hum/try to turn while the plate stays still, or is there no movement or sound at all - or is the glass plate actually broken?
it hums normally and i can hear a faint grinding/clicking from the middle when it runs. the glass plate isnt broken, i did drop it in the sink last week tho

[Heading: Likely cause: turntable coupler]
The checks point to the turntable coupler. To find the right part, could you give me the make and model number? It is usually on the back or inside the door frame.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
its a Sharp R272WM, found it on the label at the back

[Heading: Likely cause: turntable coupler]
The checks point to the turntable coupler. I could not find a confirmed match for model R272WM in our parts catalogue, so check with the manufacturer or a parts supplier using the full model number, or ask an appliance engineer to fit it.
